sections.text:
- Critical strike chance can now go past 100%. Every point above 100% is added to your
  critical damage instead, one for one: 120% crit with 200% critical damage becomes
  100% crit with 220% critical damage.
- Echo is no longer capped at 50%. Past 100%, every spell casts twice and the rest is
  your chance of a third cast: at 150% echo a spell always casts twice, and half the time
  three times.
- Spell tooltips and the character pane show the new crit and echo rules.

sections.text:
Loot is no longer endless: rings, trinkets, amulets, soulstones and guardians all have limits.
- Rings and trinkets grow toward a ceiling. Each upgrade adds less than the one before, and a
  piece never goes past five common picks' worth: a ring of damage tops out at +85%, a ring
  of damage reduction at +25%, Hand of Justice at 30%. No more 145% damage reduction.
- A piece at its ceiling is no longer offered. If that leaves a cache or a guardian's pick
  short, its last card is a pouch of gold.
- Major Soulstone holds 2 lives at most. Picking it again refills it, and it only shows up
  once you have used a life.
- Amulets grow toward three times their numbers. The first empowering is as strong as before;
  each one after it adds less.
- Guardians: every guardian you slay gives the later ones 25% more health and 5% more damage,
  and a lair fills again after 3:00 (was 2:30). They are a prize to win a few times a run,
  not a farm.

sections.text:
- Talent overhaul: every spec of every class is now about as strong as the others. The ones
  that struggled (Combat, Enhancement, Feral, Fury, Discipline, Beast Mastery, Demonology,
  Shadow) are much stronger; the ones that ran away with it (Holy priest, Destruction,
  Assassination, Affliction late on) are toned down.
- New milestones that change how you play:
  - Warrior, Fury: Rampage (every 7th kill unleashes a Whirlwind), Flurry (Whirlwind and
    Bloodthirst strike twice) and Bladestorm (you never stop spinning: a Whirlwind every 3 sec).
  - Paladin: Holy Shock's leaping bolts now come at the first Holy milestone, followed by
    Daybreak (Holy Shock crits call down Holy Wrath). Protection's Retribution Aura answers
    melee blows with Judgement; Retribution's Art of War hurls Exorcisms on crits.
  - Hunter, Marksmanship: Rapid Fire (every 6th shot is followed by a free Aimed Shot).
  - Rogue: Deadly Poison now comes first in Assassination, then Mutilate (Sinister Strike and
    Backstab strike twice). Combat's Blade Flurry sends Sinister Strike and Eviscerate on to two
    more enemies, every 20th kill brings a free Adrenaline Rush, and Killing Spree strikes on its
    own. Subtlety's Cheat Death survives a killing blow and fades you out of reach for 3 sec.
  - Priest, Discipline: you start with Power Word: Shield; Divine Aegis makes a breaking shield
    burst in holy light, Rapture raises it again at once, and Penance looses bolts of holy light
    every few seconds. Shadow: Shadowy Apparitions (Shadow Word: Pain's ticks loose free Mind
    Blasts).
  - Shaman, Enhancement: Windfury (Lightning Bolt and shocks strike twice more), Maelstrom Weapon
    (every 5th spell adds a free Chain Lightning) and spirit wolves whose bites carry Windfury.
    Restoration: Call of the Elements (you start with Searing Totem, and every totem comes with
    a twin).
  - Mage, Fire: Hot Streak (every fourth Fire crit casts a free Pyroblast).
  - Warlock: Nightfall (Shadow Bolts leave their targets corrupted), Seed of Corruption
    (afflicted enemies burst when they die) and Demonic Pact (kills tear open rifts that release
    Imps for 15 sec, up to five).
  - Druid: Starfall (a free Starfire every 4 sec), Rake (you start with Swipe and it leaves
    bleeds) and Leader of the Pack (Swipe tears around you on its own and heals you for every
    enemy it hits).
- Spells your talents cast for you (free Whirlwinds, Holy Wraths, Judgements, Chain
  Lightnings...) now hit as hard as your own copy of the spell, ranks and all. A spell you don't
  know grows with your other spells instead of staying at rank 1 all run.
- Pets bite far more often: they no longer chase a running enemy without ever landing a blow.
- Many talents' numbers retuned. Talent descriptions that showed a wrong number (Toxic Bloom,
  Pyroclasm, Explosive Ammunition, Presence of Mind, Tranquility...) now show the right one.
- Talents that were replaced give their points back: spend them again in the armory's Talents
  tab.

- The horde gets much tougher as the minutes pass, in every zone: at 15:00 enemies have
  about twice the health they had, at 20:00 more than twice. Their hits grow only a little
  more than before, so the late game is a fight to cut them down, not a few blows and you're dead.
- The horde answers how fast you kill, like in Vampire Survivors: mow it down quickly and
  enemies pour in faster (up to three times as fast), so a strong build always has something
  to fight. Fall behind and it eases back to its normal pace.
- The field never empties: clear it out and a fresh wave comes at once, and the number of
  enemies that keep coming grows with the clock.
- The game is harder overall: expect the horde to be the big threat from about 9:00 on.

- Hot Streak casts at most 2 free Pyroblasts a second, and Pyroclasm's corpses explode at most 3 times a second.

- Shadowmeld's cooldown now counts down on its button instead of staying grey.
- Leveling up no longer prints "You have gained 0 hit points." in chat.
- The Windows build no longer crashes at startup under Wine, Proton or Winlator, and gamepads work there.
